description: A function that runs around the handler with the request context and a `next` function. Handles cross-cutting concerns.
Code before `await next()` runs on the way in, code after it on the way out, in reverse order. Used by Koa and Hono.
Turns an array of middleware into one function: `dispatch(i)` calls middleware `i` with `() => dispatch(i + 1)`.
A middleware sets the response and does not call `next`, so nothing downstream runs (auth failures, cache hits).
The per-request object shared by every middleware: request data, response being built, values like `user` or `requestId`.
Wraps `next` in `try/catch` (Koa, Hono `onError`) or takes `(err, req, res, next)` (Express) to turn errors into responses.
